title: AdaptThink: Reasoning Models Can Learn When to Think
authors_zh: Jiajie Zhang、Nianyi Lin、Lei Hou、Ling Feng、Juanzi Li
paper_type_zh: 测试时推理模式选择与 RLVR 训练配方
best_for_zh: 关注推理 token 分配、Thinking/NoThinking 轨迹选择、答案验证和 rollout 审计边界的读者
one_line: Answer-verified RL chooses a full math trace or an immediate answer.
AdaptThink 以答案正确性为终点信号，结合受约束优化与重要性采样，在完整思考和直接回答两种输出模式之间学习按题目难度分配推理。
why: It turns reasoning-token allocation into trace selection and exposes missing rollout evidence.
inclusion_reason: Explicitly selects between long and no-thinking traces under answer verification.

title: Problem
问题
html: AdaptThink studies whether a reasoning model can choose between a long Thinking response and an immediate NoThinking answer on each problem. Always thinking wastes tokens on easy items, while always skipping reasoning substantially harms difficult ones. The training object is a math prompt paired with mode-conditioned on-policy responses and binary answer correctness, not a human-labeled difficulty class.
AdaptThink 研究推理模型能否针对每道题在长 Thinking 回答与直接 NoThinking 回答之间选择。始终思考会在简单题上浪费 token，始终跳过推理又会明显损害困难题。训练对象是数学提示、不同模式下的在线策略回答和二元答案正确性，而不是人工难度标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The algorithm maximizes the probability of NoThinking subject to a constraint that expected accuracy should not fall below the frozen reference model. A PPO-style objective turns the constraint into a reward-dependent penalty. Importance sampling forces half of sampled responses into Thinking and half into NoThinking, solving the cold-start problem in which the initial reasoning model almost never emits the direct-answer mode.
算法在“期望准确率不低于冻结参考模型”的约束下，提高选择 NoThinking 的概率。PPO 风格目标把该约束转化为依赖奖励的惩罚项。重要性采样强制一半回答采用 Thinking、一半采用 NoThinking，解决初始推理模型几乎从不产生直接回答模式的冷启动问题。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training uses DeepScaleR's 40K mathematics problems assembled from named AIME, AMC, Omni-Math, and STILL components. The frozen reference policy is sampled 16 times per problem to estimate its expected binary correctness. During on-policy training, mode-controlled sampling creates balanced Thinking and NoThinking groups. The reward is answer-level 0/1 mathematical correctness; the NoThinking indicator is determined by the first output control token. The constrained advantage favors direct answers only when their accuracy gap from Thinking and the reference is small enough.

The paper reports DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 7B bases, one epoch or 314 optimization steps in VeRL, response lengths up to 16,384 tokens, and evaluation on GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME 2024. A code repository and model collection are public. Complete raw response groups, reference estimates, rejected rollouts, and a record-level training manifest are not documented as released.

训练使用 DeepScaleR 的 40K 数学问题，来源包括 AIME、AMC、Omni-Math 和 STILL。冻结参考策略对每题采样 16 次，以估计其二元正确率。在线训练期间，模式控制采样构造数量平衡的 Thinking 与 NoThinking 组。奖励是答案级 0/1 数学正确性；NoThinking 由输出首个控制 token 判断。只有当直接回答相对 Thinking 与参考策略的准确率差距足够小时，约束 advantage 才鼓励 NoThinking。

论文使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 和 7B 基座，在 VeRL 中训练一个 epoch 或 314 步，回答上限为 16,384 token，并在 GSM8K、MATH500 和 AIME 2024 上评测。代码仓库和模型 collection 已公开；完整原始回答组、参考估计、被拒 rollout 和逐记录训练清单未被说明为已发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports accuracy, response length, mode-selection rate, comparisons with fixed Thinking/NoThinking and efficient-reasoning baselines, and ablations for the constraint and importance sampling. These results evaluate adaptive mode selection. They do not validate the internal reasoning of a correct answer, establish a stable difficulty label, or prove that unreleased rollouts are high-quality data. Public code and checkpoints support method inspection, while release completeness must be checked separately.
论文报告准确率、回答长度、模式选择率，并与固定 Thinking/NoThinking 和高效推理基线比较，还消融约束目标与重要性采样。这些结果评估自适应模式选择，不能验证正确答案的内部推理，也不能建立稳定难度标签，更不能证明未发布 rollout 是高质量数据。公开代码和检查点便于检查方法，但发布完整性需要另行核验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The distinctive contribution is to learn a discrete compute mode under an explicit accuracy constraint, rather than predicting a separate difficulty label or applying a fixed token budget. Mode balance is created inside the sampling distribution, so exploration of direct answers does not depend on the initial model already knowing that behavior. The feedback contract remains outcome-level correctness.
其主要贡献是在显式准确率约束下学习离散算力模式，而不是预测独立难度标签或施加固定 token 预算。模式平衡直接在采样分布中构造，因此探索直接回答不依赖初始模型已经具备该行为。反馈契约仍是结果级正确性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Binary answer checking does not verify reasoning faithfulness, and a short correct answer can be a lucky guess. The mode boundary is represented by a control-token convention and may not transfer unchanged to other model families. Reference pass-rate estimates depend on 16 samples and sampling settings. Experiments focus on verifiable mathematics; open-ended domains with judgment-based rewards remain unknown. Dataset lineage, decontamination, raw candidates, reward logs, and exact per-item mode decisions are incomplete.
二元答案检查不验证推理忠实性，短回答答对也可能只是猜中。模式边界依赖控制 token 约定，未必能原样迁移到其他模型家族。参考通过率估计只基于 16 次采样，并受采样设置影响。实验聚焦可验证数学，对判断型奖励的开放领域是否有效仍为 unknown。数据血缘、去污染、原始候选、奖励日志和逐题模式决策均不完整。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: AdaptThink is useful for constructing compute-routing records. An auditable record should retain source problem ID, reference-model samples and pass-rate estimate, forced mode, sampled response, normalized answer, correctness, importance weight, constrained advantage, chosen first token, and policy revision. Such records enable analysis of whether shorter outputs correspond to genuine easy cases or reward artifacts. Per-item rollouts, reward ledgers, and routing decisions are not completely released, so their availability remains unknown; benchmark results cannot be used to infer their record-level quality.

AdaptThink 适合构建算力路由记录。可审计记录应保留源问题 ID、参考模型样本及其通过率估计、强制模式、采样回答、规范化答案、正确性、重要性权重、约束 advantage、首个控制 token 和策略版本。借助这些字段，可以区分短回答究竟对应稳定的简单题，还是采样噪声、答案检查器或奖励塑形造成的表面节省。论文没有完整公开逐题 rollout、奖励账本和路由决策，因此这些记录的现成可得性仍为 unknown，不能从基准结果反推其数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat Thinking and NoThinking as policy-controlled output modes, not human difficulty labels.
  • The frozen reference policy is sampled 16 times per problem; its pass-rate estimate is therefore sampling-dependent.
  • On-policy sampling forces a balanced mode mixture, while the feedback itself remains binary answer correctness.
  • Inspect source IDs, normalized answers, mode tokens, importance weights, and policy versions before reusing any rollout records.
  • Accuracy and response-length gains evaluate compute routing; they do not certify the reasoning traces or unreleased training data.

• Thinking 与 NoThinking 是策略控制的输出模式，不是人工难度标签。
  • 冻结参考策略每题采样 16 次，其通过率估计会随采样设置变化。
  • 在线采样强制维持两种模式的平衡覆盖，但反馈本身仍是二元答案正确性。
  • 复用 rollout 前应核对源题 ID、规范化答案、模式 token、重要性权重和策略版本。
  • 准确率与回答长度改进只评估算力路由，不能认证推理轨迹或未公开训练数据的质量。
